verdict.rationale: Calendly's API/MCP docs show broad coverage of core scheduling actions—booking events, reading/writing contacts and notetaker data, creating event types, checking availability, and real-time webhooks—plus an MCP server that maps natural language to these API calls (calendly-docs-1,5,6,7,24,35,45,probe-3). However, several major UI capabilities referenced in Calendly's own marketing (Workflows automation, routing forms with Salesforce/HubSpot logic, payment/invoicing setup, round-robin/team admin controls, calendar sync settings) are not shown as API-exposed in this evidence pack, so full UI/API parity is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: API/MCP coverage of Workflows automation, routing-form creation/logic, payment and invoicing configuration, and admin/team settings equivalent to the UI.
